question.text: Team <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mmultiscripts><mi>A</mi><none></none><mo>'</mo><mprescripts></mprescripts><none></none><mo>'</mo></mmultiscripts></math> consists of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>7</mn></math> boys and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi></math> girls and Team <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mmultiscripts><mi>B</mi><none></none><mo>'</mo><mprescripts></mprescripts><none></none><mo>'</mo></mmultiscripts></math> has <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn></math> boys and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>6</mn></math> girls. If a total of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>52</mn></math> single matches can be arranged between these two teams when a boy plays against a boy and a girl plays against a girl, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi></math> is equal to:

solution.text:
Total matches between boys of both team=C17×C14=28

Total matches between girls of both team=C1n×C16=6n

Given, 28+6n=52

⇒n=4
